claims: SpaceX successfully launched 29 Starlink satellites via a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on Sunday, March 22, 2026.
The mission was the 37th mission of the year.
The mission followed a north-easterly trajectory.
The booster landed on a drone ship.
The location was Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40) in Florida.
The payload was 29 Starlink V2 Mini satellites.
Artemis II is set for April 2, 2026, to take four astronauts on a lunar flyby.
A Long March 2D is listed as "Go For Launch" soon, according to Space Launch Schedule.
The Spectrum rocket launch is scheduled as reported by Space Launch Schedule.
